authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant structural artifacts typical of AI generation. The most critical defect is the physical interaction between the trumpet and the sheep; the instrument appears to float or merge into the wool without any support mechanism (straps, saddle), violating gravity. Additionally, the sheep's hooves lack definition, appearing smooth and fused with the legs/grass rather than showing distinct cloven keratin structures. While the lighting and textures of the wool and brass are high quality, these anatomical and physical logic failures reduce authenticity.
